message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for the publication "TEMPO". The foreground features an illustration of a man with light skin, dark hair, and a pink collared shirt. He looks upward with an open mouth, his right hand resting on his forehead and his left hand visible near his chest, adorned with a silver-colored watch. Overlaid across the bottom-right corner of his torso is a large blue and gray pencil with a reddish eraser. The pencil appears to be erasing a portion of the man’s lower body, leaving behind dark specks. 

At the top, "TEMPO" is printed in large red capital letters. Above this, the text "HALAL-HARAM HARTA DJOKO SUSILO" and "WAWANCARA KHUSUS PILOT LION AIR" appear in black. Below the title, smaller text reads "EDISI 29 APRIL-5 MEI 2013". In the lower-left, text identifies the man as "Mohammad Nuh" and "MENTERI PENDIDIKAN DAN KEBUDAYAAN". Large black text in the lower-right reads "NILAI JEBLOK UJIAN NASIONAL". A barcode, price "RP 33.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are visible at the bottom.
